buyerTakesTicket.description: Whether one of the tickets in the order being previewed is the buyer's own. Send false when every ticket is for someone else, which is what buying for friends looks like once you already hold a ticket. It only changes how many guests fit under the event `maxTicketsPerOrder`: `maxTicketsPerOrder - 1` when true, the full allowance when false. Must match the `buyerTierId` sent to checkout, or the preflight and checkout disagree.

buyerAlreadyHasTicket.description: Whether the caller already holds an active or pending-claim ticket for this event. When true they cannot take another for themselves, and checkout rejects a `buyerTierId` with BUYER_ALREADY_HAS_TICKET - the order has to be for guests only. `valid` is false unless `buyerTakesTicket` is explicitly false.

valid.description: Whether the guest phones and buyer ticket choice are valid for checkout. A caller who already holds a ticket must explicitly validate a guest-only order.

post.description:
Answers, for phone numbers the buyer already has, whether each one holds a ticket to this cart's event and can therefore be given an addon. Needed because booking a shared room means putting someone in it who bought their own ticket.

Reveals nothing beyond that. A number with no account and a number with an account but no ticket both come back `eligible: false`, and no name is ever returned, so the response cannot be used to discover whether a stranger is registered or who they are. The cart scope means only someone mid-checkout on this event can ask at all.

post.description:
Creates a new awaiting-payment order with pricing, promo, capacity holds, and guest allocation. Returns 201 on first creation, 200 on identical retry.

**Deprecated.** This route is ticket-only: it cannot carry addons, it prices and holds capacity in the same call so there is no way to show a total before committing, and it opens a Paymob intention immediately. New clients use the Cart flow instead — `POST /mobile/carts`, `PUT .../tickets`, `POST .../preview`, `POST .../place-order`, then `POST /mobile/orders/{orderId}/payment/initiate`.

It stays in service only for app builds already in the wild that call it. Remove it once the Cart-based build is the minimum supported version.
